# Toolkit Readiness Audit (100 apps)

> Agent-researched readiness of 100 SaaS apps to become agent toolkits: login method, self-serve access, API, MCP, verdict and blocker, each with a cited source.
> Accuracy on held-out apps: first draft 81.7% -> final 91.7%. Audit sample: 83.9% -> 92.2% after automated checks.

## Files
- https://rkstlohchab.github.io/toolkit-readiness-audit/data.json: one record per app
- https://rkstlohchab.github.io/toolkit-readiness-audit/data.csv: same, flat
- https://rkstlohchab.github.io/toolkit-readiness-audit/scores.json: accuracy per pass/field and every miss
- https://rkstlohchab.github.io/toolkit-readiness-audit/patterns.json: aggregates
- https://github.com/rkstlohchab/toolkit-readiness-audit: code
